In the distance, the skyline extends toward Siam to Pratunam Area, with numerous high-rise commercial and residential buildings. The photograph show the contrast between the university campus, established low-rise urban structures, green spaces, and the ongoing development of Bangkok's modern skyline.

association.description: These prayer bells at Wat Thepleela are rung by Buddhist devotees and other temple visitors, to bring good luck, good health and success in life. Over each one is a caption with a short description of the bell's significance. Wat Thepleela is located at Soi Ramkhamhaeng 39, Hua Mak, Bangkok, Thailand. It can be reached also with the Saen Saep canal ferry. The temple has the distinction of being a "Royal Temple", founded during the reign of King Rama III. In 2016, the engine of one of the Saen Saep canal ferries exploded at the Wat Thepleela pier, injuring 58 people.
